diagnosis.observation: The round-1 unit lessons held everywhere: all 8 episodes carry 3 error units (round 1: mean 2.75), k_effective 3/3, zero stacking or duplicate penalties, 8/8 format-valid. P1/P2 edits paid off structurally.

r_P 0.0417 -> 0.2917. Type diversification widened to 12 families; incomplete_solution, duplication_error and decimal_magnitude each survived with 0% detection (unsimplified expression ep00, dropped factor in expansion ep01, 7200->720 magnitude slip ep04), and computation-line wrong_operation errors survived at 0.667 (radical rewrite ep03 err_002, like-term combination ep03 err_003, division line ep04 err_001).

Saturated families: denominator_only 3/3, tacking_signs 1/1, variable_misconception 1/1, whole_number_bias 1/1, wrong_fraction 1/1, additive_thinking 1/1, geometry_definition 1/1. Isolated-constant changes remain the weakest play.

policy_edits.change: Named the misconception families with rich internal structure (incomplete simplification, duplicated operation, decimal/place-value slips, errors on the arithmetic line) as the preferred plays, and named the saturated ones (denominator-only, end-tacked sign, isolated constant swap) as plays to retire.

Added an explicit complete-statement floor: a bare number, lone sign, or single symbol is not an expression; span the smallest enclosing statement carrying the mistake (whole equality with its computed value, or whole clause).

scorer_issues.pattern: err_003 declared the micro-span '$b/a$' (5 chars, below the complete-expression rule the prompt already requires) and scored as a clean miss with no penalty. The matcher's containment rule floors the shorter text at 40% of the longer, so a context-bearing quote can never align with a micro-span: sub-expression spans are systematically undetectable and therefore systematically rewarded. The policy rule exists but no guard enforces it.
scorer_issues.guard: matcher containment rule / schema span-size check
